CHAPTER 2
Seasons declared, then honoured.

Define four windows, set the price floor for each, and let the calendar take it from there. Special weeks override season — bank holidays, festivals — without altering the rest.

Edit season windows

CHAPTER 4
Distributed, but never duplicated.

When you publish, the calendar pushes outward in three minutes — to the direct booking page, to Airbnb, to the partner channels you've selected at the agency. Distribution is a function of patience; remember, every reservation arrives in a small, measured form.
